bore_liner.name: Bore Liner
bore_liner.torque: Cover clips only. No fasteners into the gradient assembly, ever.
bore_liner.service_interval: Inspect at every PM for cracks and patient fluid ingress
bore_liner.safety: The magnet is ALWAYS on. Only non-ferrous tools inside the 5 gauss line.
bore_liner.notes: A cracked liner lets cleaning fluid reach the gradient coil. Cheap part, catastrophic failure mode.

rf_body_coil.name: RF Body Coil (transmit)
rf_body_coil.torque: Per OEM torque sequence only. Uneven load detunes the coil.
rf_body_coil.tool_required: Non-ferrous kit, network analyser for retune
rf_body_coil.safety: Transmits at kilowatt levels. Never energise with covers off.
rf_body_coil.notes: Detuning shows up as a shading artifact across the whole field of view.

gradient_coil.name: Gradient Coil Assembly
gradient_coil.torque: Not field serviceable. Replacement is an OEM engineer job.
gradient_coil.service_interval: Temperature log reviewed at every PM
gradient_coil.safety: Water cooled and epoxy potted. A cracked coil can arc.
gradient_coil.notes: This is the single most expensive failure on the system. Overheating is almost always a chiller problem upstream, so fix the chiller before you condemn the coil.

shim_tray.name: Passive Shim Trays
shim_tray.torque: Slide-in trays, retaining screw hand tight
shim_tray.service_interval: Reshim after any major service or building change
shim_tray.safety: Trays hold steel plates. They are strongly attracted. Two people.
shim_tray.notes: Homogeneity drift over months usually means the building changed, not the magnet.

magnet_coil.name: Superconducting Magnet Coils
magnet_coil.torque: Not field serviceable under any circumstances.
magnet_coil.safety: Niobium-titanium at 4 Kelvin. Always energised unless deliberately ramped down or quenched.
magnet_coil.notes: If you are looking at these, the job is above field-service level. Call the OEM.

cryostat.name: Cryostat / Helium Vessel
cryostat.service_interval: Helium level logged weekly, vacuum checked annually
cryostat.safety: Holds ~1500 litres of liquid helium. A vacuum failure causes rapid boil-off.
cryostat.notes: Frost anywhere on the outer shell means the vacuum is compromised. Stop and escalate.

gantry_cover.name: Gantry Cover
gantry_cover.torque: Plastic clips and captive nylon screws only
gantry_cover.safety: Covers off means RF exposed. Do not scan.
gantry_cover.notes: Cosmetic, but a cracked cover fails the annual safety inspection.

patient_table.name: Patient Table
patient_table.torque: Drive belt tension per OEM gauge
patient_table.service_interval: Landmark calibration every 6 months, load test annually
patient_table.safety: Emergency table release must be tested at every PM. A patient can be trapped in the bore.
patient_table.notes: Landmark drift of more than 2 mm invalidates every localiser you run.

head_coil.name: Head Receive Coil (32ch)
head_coil.torque: Connector seats by hand. Never force it.
head_coil.service_interval: Phantom QA weekly, full element check quarterly
head_coil.safety: Do not scan with a damaged coil. Broken elements can cause RF burns.
head_coil.notes: Dropped coils are the number one cause of SNR complaints. Element failures are invisible until you run a phantom.

cold_head.name: Cold Head (cryocooler)
cold_head.torque: Mounting bolts 12 Nm, crossed pattern, non-ferrous socket
cold_head.tool_required: Non-ferrous socket set, helium recovery line
cold_head.service_interval: Replace every 3 years or 26000 running hours
cold_head.safety: Swap must be done within the OEM time window or the magnet starts boiling off.
cold_head.notes: A knocking or irregular cold head is the earliest warning of helium loss. It runs at about 1 Hz - if the rhythm is off, act now, not next month.

quench_pipe.name: Quench Pipe
quench_pipe.torque: Building infrastructure. Not a field-replaceable part.
quench_pipe.service_interval: Visually verify clear path to outside at every PM
quench_pipe.safety: If this is blocked, a quench vents helium into the magnet room and displaces the oxygen. This kills people.
quench_pipe.notes: Check for ice, bird nests and building work. This is the single most important five-second check on the whole system.

he_level_sensor.name: Helium Level Sensor
he_level_sensor.service_interval: Reading logged weekly, trend reviewed monthly
he_level_sensor.safety: A false-high reading hides real helium loss. Trust the trend, not the number.
he_level_sensor.notes: Normal is above 60 percent with less than 0.05 percent per day drift. Anything faster, escalate.

compressor.name: Helium Compressor
compressor.torque: Self-sealing couplings, hand tight plus quarter turn
compressor.service_interval: Adsorber replacement every 3 years, static pressure checked monthly
compressor.safety: Lives in the equipment room, outside the 5 gauss line. Normal tools are fine here.
compressor.notes: Static pressure should read 225 psi at 20 C. Low static means a leak, and the cold head will lose cooling power long before anyone notices.

chiller.name: Water Chiller
chiller.notes: Most gradient over-temperature shutdowns are a dirty chiller filter, not a bad gradient coil. Always check here first - it is a 200 rupee fix versus a 1.2 crore one.

gradient_amplifier.name: Gradient Amplifier
gradient_amplifier.service_interval: Fault log reviewed at every PM, fans cleaned annually
gradient_amplifier.safety: Several hundred volts on the busbars. Lock out and verify zero before opening.
gradient_amplifier.notes: Read the fault log before touching anything. It usually names the axis that tripped.

penetration_panel.name: RF Penetration Panel
penetration_panel.torque: Panel screws 2 Nm, every single one fitted
penetration_panel.safety: Every unfiltered cable through this panel is an antenna into your images.
penetration_panel.notes: If a contractor ran a new cable through here without a filter, that is your zipper artifact. Ask what changed in the room recently.

rf_door_seal.name: RF Shielded Door + Finger Stock
rf_door_seal.torque: Finger stock clips in, no fasteners
rf_door_seal.service_interval: Finger stock inspected quarterly, RF test annually
rf_door_seal.safety: A door that does not seal fails the room's RF certification.
rf_door_seal.notes: Bent or missing finger stock is the most common RF leak on any site. Run a fingertip along the whole perimeter - you will feel the gap before an instrument finds it.

erdu.name: Emergency Rundown Unit
erdu.service_interval: Presence and labelling verified at every PM. NEVER function tested.
erdu.safety: Pressing this deliberately quenches the magnet. It costs roughly 40 lakh to re-ramp and takes the site down for a week. Press it ONLY to free a person trapped against the magnet.
erdu.notes: Not a power-off button. Staff routinely think it is. That misunderstanding is worth training out.
